finding.text: The task folder has no `task.jsonl`, and the requirements said to write the three test numbers there. They exist only inside `session.jsonl` (scrollTop 0 at 400 and 1200; follow at the bottom; stay put at the top). A fresh agent cannot find the evidence from the task folder alone, so re-log them through `node .claude/hooks/append.mjs`.

The new `locked` option on `sticky_scroll` (`public/framework/ext/Chat/Chat.js:409`) is not described in `public/framework/ext/Chat/doc/notes.md` (sticky-scroll section, around line 83), which documents `observe` and the three callers. Add `locked:false` and its one caller, /live/.

`public/live/readme.md:5` still reads as if /live/ opens pinned ("It follows new cards while you are at the bottom"). The new "opens at the top" sentence was added only deep in the table row at line 72. Say it in line 5 too, next to "Settings and a file view open at the top".

`public/live/LivePage.js:314` starts unlocked. If a page is short enough that it does not scroll and cards later push it past one screen, no scroll event fires, so it may never lock and never follow. This looks fine for "never scrolled to the bottom never moves", but check whether `sticky_scroll` treats "already at bottom" as locked on the first overflow.

The card-text change is small and correct: `LivePage.Md` takes `fallback` (`public/live/LivePage.js:475-486`) and `Preview.draw` uses `description || text` at line 790, so the `$theirs` fallback still works. The simpler alternative, choosing the key once, would not follow edits, so this is the right call.

The chat path is unchanged: both new defaults (`locked = true`, `observe = true`) preserve today's behaviour. The smoke run reported one layout error on /live/done/ ("a mentio…"). Confirm it predates this change; I could not tell from the diff.
